params.name: Apply automatically
params.tooltip:
On: right after you build a roundabout, a slip lane,
a crossroads or a T-junction, its junctions get smart lanes.
Off: only the Smart Lanes road tool changes lanes.

params.name: No lights at roundabouts and ramps
params.tooltip:
On: turns off the game's automatic traffic lights at roundabouts
and where a slip lane or ramp leaves or joins a road, right
after you build them and when you use the Smart Lanes tool.
Crossroads and T-junctions keep the game's own choice.
Off: the game decides everywhere.

params.name: Free kerb turn at traffic lights
params.tooltip:
When safe: at crossroads and T-junctions with traffic lights,
the turn towards the kerb (right in right-hand traffic, left in
left-hand traffic) also goes in light phases where nothing
crosses its path: no green traffic into a lane nearer the kerb,
no green crosswalk on the two roads it drives over. It may
merge with green traffic that enters the same lane.
Always: free in every phase, even across green traffic and
crosswalks (turning vehicles do not give way).
Set when Smart Lanes handles the junction, after you build it
or with the Smart Lanes tool; the tool's Reset locks it again.
Off: the game's phases (the turn waits with its road).

params.name: Light phases
params.tooltip:
Game default: crossroads and T-junctions with traffic lights
keep the game's own light phases.
Smart Lanes: Smart Lanes plans their phases from its lanes.
Only movements that neither cross nor merge go together, so
turns across oncoming traffic get their own green. Kerb turns
also go where they only merge into green traffic (as Free kerb
turn When safe). Pedestrians cross beside parallel traffic or
in their own phase, and a short all-red follows every phase.
Set when Smart Lanes handles the junction, after you build it
or with the Smart Lanes tool; the tool's Reset restores the
game's phases. Free kerb turn is not applied on top: the plan
already lets kerb turns go wherever When safe would.

params.name: Debug: performance log
params.tooltip:
Off: normal play. On: every 30 s, Smart Lanes writes how
long its build handling and road tool took to the game's log
file (stdout.txt, lines starting with [SQPERF]), plus the
road tool's hover diagnostics ([SQRL] PROBE lines). Only for
tracking down slowdowns; leave it Off otherwise. Slow calls
are always logged briefly, whatever this setting.
